description: Concentrated neutral cleaner with a very high yield, ideal for daily cleaning and maintenance of surfaces, including marble and natural stones
whereToUse: marble, granite and all natural stones, perfect for use on polished natural stones that are sensitive to aggressive detergents
parquet with oil or paint finish
flooring in LVT, linoleum, rubber and PVC
acrylic resin flooring created using Mapecoat TNS range
notFor: Do not use UltraCare Multicleaner undiluted.
UltraCare Multicleaner on waxed surfaces can be used only diluted.
Use on methacrylate baths only when diluted.

consumption.basis: one litre of product diluted in a ratio of 1 : 200 with water
consumption.quote: Diluted in a ratio of 1 : 200 with water, it is possible to clean approximately 1500 m² of surface area with a litre of UltraCare Multicleaner.

mixing: Dilute UltraCare Multicleaner with water in a ratio from 1 : 20 to 1 : 200 depending on the degree of concentration required and the level of dirt to be removed.
packaging: UltraCare Multicleaner is available in 1- and 5-litre jerrycans.
storage: UltraCare Multicleaner, stored in the original packaging, has a storage time of 3 years.
notes: 1) The title is printed on two lines ('ULTRACARE' / 'MULTICLEANER'). 2) Coverage is given only for the 1 : 200 dilution (approximately 1500 m² per litre); no figure for 1 : 30 or 1 : 20. The sheet adds: 'Consumption may vary based on dilution, the degree and type of dirt, and the surface to be treated.' 3) Dosing figures given in the application text (not coverage): 1 : 200 = '50 ml of product in 10 litres of water' for daily maintenance, no rinsing needed; up to 1 : 20 = '500 ml of product in 10 litres of water' for extraordinary maintenance, rinsing needed; 1 : 30 for the initial clean after installation on delicate surfaces. 4) The sheet calls the product 'neutral' and refers to its 'neutral pH', while the technical data table prints pH: 8. 5) The table row 'Waiting time before rinsing: 5 minutes' sits alongside body text saying that at 1 : 200 rinsing is not necessary. The sentence 'The surface must be rinsed when used in a dilution of less than 1 : 200' is loosely worded; from context it means stronger (more concentrated) mixes than 1 : 200. 6) No standards or classifications are stated. The WHERE TO USE list has exactly 8 items and all are included.
